name: Pairwise Reduction Trap
description: Transforms a global exact-cover constraint into a pairwise local constraint (Hamming distance = 3). Models that pattern-match will perceive it as a Maximum Clique or Independent Set problem and generate generic graph backtracking algorithms that TLE. Models that genuinely reason will deduce that a k-clique in this specific graph mathematically forces a permutation over the coordinates, reformulate it back to Exact Cover, and use efficient coordinate-branching (Algorithm X) to pass.
